glyph_origin: First attested in early Western Zhou bronze inscriptions as a 行 (“road”) + 首 (“head”), later augmented with 又 (寸) or 止 in the middle and late periods. The 亍 on the right eventually disappeared, leading to the semantic components combining into 辵 in the seal script.
senses: [dào] (literary, colloquial, in, northern Mandarin) path; course; way; road
[dào] (historical) circuit (various administrative divisions of imperial and early Republican China)
[dǎo] (Classical) alternative form of 導 (“to direct; to guide; to lead”)
